raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
The Qwen3.8-Flash-Next cookbook's B300 AgentX entry uses the RadixArk checkpoint. Add the NVIDIA NVFP4 configurations from [InferenceX #4683](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4683) to its existing interactive builder, with the digest-pinned SGLang image and checkpoint revisions.

Cover TP4/EP4 at concurrency 1 and 2, TP1 GPU KV at 1, 2, 12 and 24, and TP1 HiCache at 48 and 80. Preserve per-configuration kernel, graph, memory, admission, speculative-decoding and cache settings. Explain the 298 GB HiCache host-memory allocation and the cache behavior assumptions for replay traffic. Retain the generated historical dataset unchanged; a separate source module adds the new entries without changing indexed references in existing entries. Expose only the submitted SGLang topology and cache tier for these configurations.

Validation: [run 41117066222, attempt 1](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/41117066222/attempts/1) passed all eight benchmark configurations, both eval jobs and result collection on source head `d06564bc533cc54584ef6a35837336a2b4b84421`. Entries are marked verified against the source PR, pending its merge. These production commands omit synthetic acceptance controls; no throughput or accuracy claim is made. The pinned nightly's flags must not be assumed compatible with other releases.

<details><summary>AI model disclosure</summary>

OpenAI GPT-6-based Codex prepared the cookbook changes and local validation. The exact runtime model identifier could not be verified.

</details>

完整 sweep 的八个 benchmark 配置、两个 eval job 和结果收集均已通过；新增配置标记为源 PR 已验证、待合并。生产命令不包含合成接受长度设置，不宣称性能或准确率已经验证。

@@ -79,8 +79,13 @@ Agentic workloads, such as coding agents and other multi-turn, tool-using assist
 
 import { AgentX } from "/src/snippets/_agentx.jsx";
 import { agentx } from "/src/snippets/agentx/Qwen/qwen3.8-flash-next.jsx";
+import { b300Cells } from "/src/snippets/agentx/Qwen/qwen3.8-flash-next-b300.jsx";
 
-<AgentX data={agentx} />
+The B300 HiCache configurations reserve 298 GB of host memory for the combined target/draft KV and Mamba pool, in addition to pinned PLE embeddings and process overhead. Provision sufficient free host RAM and container shared memory before starting them. GPU KV configurations also offload PLE embeddings to host memory.
+
+For the B300 NVIDIA configurations at concurrency 12 and above, `--mamba-track-interval 262144` reduces intermediate state checkpoints. The concurrency-80 configuration also uses `--strip-thinking-cache` and `--mamba-max-states-per-path 2`. These settings target replay traffic that does not resend model output; reassess prefix reuse for conversational clients that do.
+
+<AgentX data={{ ...agentx, cells: [...agentx.cells, ...b300Cells] }} />
